provenance.note: Synthetic paired control probe; not historical runtime evidence, accepted lore, a model result, or authorization to activate semantic testing.

operation: Assess only what a required ritual establishes about belief.
boundary: Synthetic Temple declaration and actors; no real AetherFire canon, private motives, or chosen actions.
input: A Temple declares doctrine X and requires residents to repeat it in a ritual. A participates under this requirement. A god's existence is explicitly established, but A's access to evidence and private belief are not. BASE: these are the only premises. VARIANT: add explicit evidence that A sincerely believes X. State what can be concluded in each version. Participation and institutional declaration alone do not establish sincere belief or disbelief; the added private-state evidence does support the bounded belief claim. Do not universalize either result to all Temple members or residents.
protected_distinction: RITUAL / INSTITUTIONAL DECLARATION != PRIVATE BELIEF; ESTABLISHED BELIEF MAY BE AFFIRMED
forbidden_conversion: Infer universal belief, universal disbelief, hidden dissent, or motive from forced participation or divine existence; refuse the explicitly established sincere belief.
